datasets.name: Transactions_lazytr
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  p.ID,
  P.rowid,
  p.vid_op,ad.name as custname,
  p.OP_ID as OperatorID,
  p.no_prov as OperationNo,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  p.DEBT as DebitID,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,SUBSTR (ad.ACC_NO, 9, 20) AS D_Accno, --(select substr(ad.ACC_NO,9,20) from dual)as D_Accno,
  p.VAL_ACC as DebitCurrencyID,
  ad.CurrencyName as DebitCurrencySName, --dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ad.filial as DebitBranch,
  p.KREDIT as CreditID,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,SUBSTR (ac.ACC_NO, 9, 20)  AS C_Accno, --(select substr(ac.ACC_NO,9,20) from dual)as C_Accno,
  p.CurrencyID_C as CreditCurrencyID,
  ac.CurrencyName as CreditCurrencySName, --cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  ac.filial as CreditBranch,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Rate_D as DebitRate,
  p.Rate_C as CreditRate,
  p.Bank_D as DebitBank,
  p.Bank_K as CreditBank,
  p.NO_PACK as PackageNumber,
  p.SHIFR as CYPHERCODE,
  sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(p.vid_op, p.val_acc, p.currencyID_c) as OPERATIONCODE,
  p.Kassa_B as INBALANCECHAR,
  p.Kassa_Z as OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance,ac.bal_cn1 as KreditBalance,
  p.Name,
  p.userinsert as usr, --sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.op_id) as usr ,
  '' as usrcommit ,

  0 as Flags,
  decode(Rejected, 0, 1, 3) as status,
  RejectReason as REJECT_REASON,
  p.reportid,
  p.countrid,
  p.bdg_code,
  p.d1


FROM
    account ad,
    account ac,
    --avalute_t dc,
    --avalute_t cc,
    LAZYTRANSACTION p
where 
    nvl(p.k1,0) not in(1,3)and
    p.dat =:TransactionDate
    and (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    --and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    --and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
  and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
        not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
        or
        (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))
    and ad.bal_cn1=41010
    and (ac.bal_cn1 in(25129,15010) or ac.old_acc_no=1)
  
 order by  p.vid_op

  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance,ac.bal_cn1 as KreditBalance,
  p.Name,
  p.userinsert as usr, --sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.op_id) as usr ,
  p.usercommit as usrcommit, --sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.commit_opid) as usrcommit ,
  0 as Flags,
  2 as status,
  '' as REJECT_REASON,
  p.reportid,
  p.countrid,
  p.bdg_code,
  p.d1

FROM
    account ad,
    account ac,
    --avalute_t dc,
    --avalute_t cc,
    provarch p
where
    p.dat =:TransactionDate
    and (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    --and (ad.val_acc = p.val_acc)
    --and (ac.val_acc = p.CurrencyID_C)
    --and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    --and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
          not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
          or
          (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))
       and kredit in(select id from account where bal_cn1 in(25129,15010) or old_acc_no=1)
order by  p.vid_op

datasets.name: ods_m10_chek
datasets.sql:
select p.id creditid,
i.phone_m,(select ammount from lazytransaction where id=:trid)ammount,i.passpin
from cm_active_credits p,custinfo i where p.boorowerid=i.idcust 
and p.id in (select creditid from cm_tranches where tranzittrid=:trid)

datasets.name: ods_payout_chek
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  s.phone,s.amount,s.external_operation_id,s.cr_id,
  JSON_VALUE(s.response_text, '$.status.code') AS status_code,
  JSON_VALUE(s.response_text, '$.status.description') AS status_description,
  JSON_VALUE(s.response_text, '$.payload.operationId') AS operation_id,
  JSON_VALUE(s.response_text, '$.payload.externalOperationId') AS external_operation_id,
  JSON_VALUE(s.response_text, '$.payload.operationStatus') AS operation_status,
  
  st.external_operation_id,st.checked_at,
  JSON_VALUE(st.status_response, '$.status.code') AS status_code_s,
  JSON_VALUE(st.status_response, '$.status.description') AS status_description_s,
  JSON_VALUE(st.status_response, '$.payload.operationStatus') AS operation_status_s
FROM payouts s,payout_status st where JSON_VALUE(s.response_text, '$.payload.operationId')=st.external_operation_id
and s.cr_id=:v_creditid
ORDER BY s.id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
